protocol.table_estimator: H_{i,b}+(N/M) 1{i in S}(g_{i,b}(U)-H_{i,b}); refresh sampled table entries after estimation
protocol.table_scope: Client-component gradient table estimator; neither SCAFFOLD nor original shared-variable SAGA
protocol.equal_budget: Each method spends 8000 client-block gradient calls. Geometric/HT: 1000 updates. Table: 128 full-table initialization calls plus 984 updates*8 calls. Table uses the same first 984 draws of the common 1000-draw schedule.
protocol.memory: Table adds N*B*block_dimension=1024 float64 entries=8192 bytes, excluding state/method-independent arrays. Dense reference, no measured communication reduction.
protocol.output: Uniform random pre-update prefix for each method at its available update count; final iterate is a separate diagnostic
protocol.running_mapping: Exact mean over pre-update full squared proximal mappings. These are deterministic full mappings, not the Moreau-envelope gradient.
protocol.budget_running_mapping: Full-table initialization consumes 128 calls at the unchanged initial mapping; subsequent pre-update mappings weighted by M=8 calls. Average over equal total oracle work.
protocol.full_mapping_parameter: mu=1/(2L), Hilbert average-client metric; L=6 for separable case, L=6.8 for coupled case
protocol.diagnostics: N*B*(T_method+1) extra client-block derivative diagnostics; excluded from training budget, never supplied to any training estimator/cache. Objective/population evaluation also external diagnostics.
protocol.preprocessing: 32768 scalar observations generated/read per data run; empirical linear coefficients are sufficient statistics, identically available to all methods. No uncharged training-gradient-table initialization.
protocol.randomization: 20 independent data/update seed pairs per case; methods paired on both seeds and on common schedule prefix; independent data and algorithm RNGs
protocol.error_bars: Sample SD across runs; paired-mean descriptive 95% t intervals use df=19, no multiple-comparison correction
protocol.structure: First two blocks have zero population tilts. Coupled-case structure metrics concern these signal labels, not population-minimizer sharing labels. Fusion tolerance 1e-10.
protocol.limitations: Synthetic exact-gradient dense NumPy reference; fixed equal step, no per-method tuning, no application/communication/large-model speed claim; common noisy objective and strong nonconvex initialization only two controlled cases.
